final: WITH g AS (SELECT orderslink AS ref, AVG(rebrate * 1.0 / feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.ref, g.avg_ratio, g.n, g.avg_ratio / ov.overall AS rel FROM g CROSS JOIN ov WHERE ov.overall IS NOT NULL) SELECT ref, avg_ratio, n, rel FROM r ORDER BY (rel IS NULL), rel DESC LIMIT 10
